Hospital 1 -- * EmployeeAn Employee has A Hospital. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Hospital.A Hospital has some Employees. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When an Employee is created, its Hospital must be assigned. When an Employee is deleted, its Hospital is not deleted and its list of Employees is decreased. When a Hospital is deleted, its Employees are not deleted. They are assigned to another Hospital.
